tagline: A little more thoughtful. A little more human.
loginHelp: Enter the administration token configured on your server. A protected session keeps you signed in for up to 7 days, until you disconnect or the server restarts. The token is not saved in browser storage.
networkError: Unable to connect. Check the server and try again.
overviewHelp: A calm place to keep an eye on your companion.
setupHelp: Add a provider, create model instances, and assign ordered routes to Planner and Thinker. Credentials remain on the server.
privacyHelp: Person memories stay inside their scene. Simulation never learns persistently or sends to a real platform. Temporary conversation state is not restored after restart.
savedNextTurn: Saved. New turns use these settings.
modelsHelp: Providers, independent model instances, and explicit fallback order.
emptyProviders: No providers yet. Add one to begin.
name: Display name
credentialHelp: Variable name only. Set its secret value on the server, never here.
routeHelp: The first compatible instance is tried first. A new turn returns to the preferred instance. Same API names may use different providers.
addModel: Add a model to this route
personaHelp: Only manual editing changes this template. Learning cannot rewrite it.
scenesHelp: Participation and learning are independent. Unconfigured scenes do not speak or learn. Private chats are passive only.
logsHelp: Technical events only, with bounded disk rotation. Raw chat is excluded. Optional sensitive model previews remain in memory only.
simulationBoundary: Isolated simulation: no real-scene reads, persistent learning, or platform sends.
previewBoundary: Read-only platform preview. This page does not send as the bot.
emptyChat: Start a conversation, or let silence be a valid choice.
memePrivacyHelp: Generic assets can be used across scenes after a shareability assessment; you can adjust sharing manually. Platform animation playback has not been verified live.
emptyMemes: No media yet. Enable learning and a vision route, then receive supported QQ CDN images through SnowLuma.
reviewedSharing: I reviewed this as generic, privacy-safe shared media
memoryHelp: Manage scene-scoped experiences and explicitly shared public knowledge. There are no global person profiles.
memoryPersonHelp: Optional; this person is remembered only inside the selected scene.
memoryPublicWarning: Public knowledge must contain no private experiences, internal projects, or person profiles. Removing names is not enough.
memoryPublicConfirm: I have verified that this content is genuinely public and non-personal.
memoryPersonFilter: Exact person ID within a scene
memorySourceWarning: References are provenance, not guaranteed available raw messages.
memoryDeleteConfirm: Delete this memory and its search data? A deletion marker prevents automatic relearning of the same content in this scope.
rulesHelp: Manual constraints are separate from learned preferences. Save changes to apply them to new turns.
rulesHierarchy: Fixed role → manual rules → learned preferences → retrieved material. Learning never rewrites the fixed role.
rulesNonOverridable: Cannot be overridden by scene rules
personaVersionsHelp: These are manually saved template versions, not model-generated hidden reasoning.
personaVersionsEmpty: No saved role revisions yet. The current role is in Settings.
pluginsHelp: Trusted local extensions, capability declarations, and configuration.
pluginsTrust: Local plugins run with host permissions. Install only code you trust; this is not an untrusted-code sandbox.
pluginSaved: Configuration saved. Enabled plugins are reloaded and connections may be rebuilt.
pluginUnsaved: Save or discard this draft before switching plugins or changing enabled state.
pluginSecretHelp: Stored values are never shown. Leave blank to keep the existing secret.
pluginReloadHelp: Saving an enabled plugin reloads it. Reload cancels pending plugin work and reconnects; it does not restart the entire service.
pluginChoose: Choose a plugin to inspect its configuration.
probeSaveFirst: Save or reset changes before discovery or capability probes.
probeChargeWarning: This sends a real request using the saved model and may incur provider charges. Continue?
probeHelp: Manual tests use only this saved model, with no fallback. Vision checks image-input acceptance, not visual understanding. Results do not change declared capabilities.
priceOptionalHelp: Optional. Leave blank when unknown; zero means explicitly free.
usageEstimateHelp: Estimates use configured prices at call time, not provider bills. Unpriced calls are unknown, not free. These statistics do not impose a spending cap.
modelConcurrencyHelp: Limits in-flight requests, not spending. Planner and thinker work takes priority over learning and background analysis.
participationWindowsHelp: Soft hints in the instance timezone, not mandatory replies or a hard schedule. Participation switches remain authoritative. Split overnight windows at midnight; start must precede end.
debugModelIOHelp: Sensitive visible model input/output only; no hidden reasoning. Kept in memory for up to 15 minutes / 20 entries, not on disk. Disable when finished; disabling or restarting clears it.
priceInvalid: Prices must be finite nonnegative numbers, or blank when unknown.
learnedHintsHelp: Low-weight sourced preferences, never higher priority than your rules. Lock to prevent new learning; recalls still invalidate withdrawn evidence.
visibleDiagnosticsHelp: Sensitive temporary previews. No hidden reasoning; recalls and disabling debugging clear these records.
transientStateHelp: Read-only topic attention and task counts. No chat bodies or inferred human emotions; state is discarded on restart.
learningBatchHelp: Coalesce live messages before scoped learning. Smaller windows may make more provider calls; no spending cap.
automaticPrivacyReview: Conservative automated privacy review; not a perfect privacy guarantee.
uxSetupRoutes: Assign Planner and Thinker models to start a conversation.
uxNoActivity: No technical events yet. Configuration and runtime events will appear here.
uxNoScenesMatch: No matching scenes. Scenes appear after adapter messages arrive.
uxNoPersistentChats: Simulation is temporary. Platform previews never send messages.
uxChatEmptyHelp: Try a conversation with the configured models. Nothing is sent to a real platform.
uxPreviewEmptyHelp: Select a scene to inspect the available platform history.
uxNoMatches: No matching entries. Add one or adjust your filters.
uxDraftHelp: Changes stay in this draft until you choose Save.
uxEditorDraftHelp: Close keeps the draft. Cancel restores this editor’s initial values. Save applies all configuration changes.
uxProviderInUse: Remove or reassign this provider’s model instances before deleting it.
mcIntro: Connect a service → add models → choose a model for each task.
mcSearchProviders: Search provider name, protocol or address…
mcSearchModels: Search model name, API identifier or provider…
mcDisplayNameHelp: Only used as a display name in HumanEngine.
mcProviderHelp: Determines the endpoint, API protocol and credential.
mcApiNameHelp: The model identifier sent to the provider, not the display name above.
mcProtocolHelp: Choose the API interface supported by this endpoint, not the provider brand.
mcCredentialHelp: Enter your API key here. It is encrypted in the database and never returned to this page. Leave blank to keep the saved key.
mcDeclaredHelp: Declare these according to the provider documentation. Selecting a capability does not verify it.
mcSaveBeforeVerify: Save this model before verifying its current configuration.
mcDiscoveryEmpty: The provider returned no model names. You can still enter an identifier manually.
mcDiscoveryFailure: Could not load the model list. Manual entry remains available.
mcSavedProviderRequired: Save this provider before requesting its model list.
mcNoProvidersHelp: A model needs a provider for its API address, protocol and credential.
mcNoModelsHelp: Add a model from an existing provider, then assign it to a role.
mcAssignmentHelp: Each task tries compatible models in this order. If one fails, the next is used. A new turn starts with the primary model again.
mcRolePlannerHelp: Plans how to reply, gathers evidence and chooses memes/tools. Configure a capable text + tools model independently; no model is selected automatically.
mcRoleThinkerHelp: Turns the grounded plan into natural dialogue quickly. Configure its text + tools model independently; planning and complex research remain with Planner.
mcRoleLearningHelp: Extracts memories and reusable knowledge in the background.
mcRoleVisionHelp: Interprets images and sampled animation frames.
mcRoleEmbeddingHelp: Creates vectors for semantic memory search.
mcDiscardHelp: Only this editor's unsaved changes will be discarded. Saved configuration is unchanged.
mcDeleteModelHelp: This also removes it from {count} task assignment lists. Other models and saved memories are not deleted.
mcDeleteProviderHelp: This removes the saved connection configuration. It does not delete the provider account.
mcProviderInUse: This provider is used by {count} models. Move or delete those models before deleting the provider.
mcConfigChanged: This record changed or was removed elsewhere. Close the editor and reload before trying again.
mcRequiredCapability: Select at least one declared capability.
mcSaved: Saved. The new configuration applies to the next turn.
mcAddFallback: Add a model to the call order…
mmCreateHelp: Choose the scope first. Person-specific memory belongs to one conversation only.
mmDiscardHelp: Discard only this memory draft. Saved memories are unchanged.
mmLockHelp: Locking prevents automatic edits; recalled sources can still invalidate the memory.
mmEmptyHelp: Try another scope or search, or add a manual memory.
mmViewMemory: View full memory and source details
mmConfidenceHelp: Stored confidence, not independently verified truth. Enter a value between 0 and 1.
mmNoSources: No source references are available for display.
mmNoScenes: No conversations are available yet. Connect an adapter and receive a message first.
mmImmutableScope: Scope cannot be changed here. This edit does not move memory to another conversation.
mmStatusHelp: Changing status does not restore recalled source messages.
scHelp: Control replies and learning separately for each group or private conversation.
scSearch: Search conversation name or platform identifier…
scImmediateHelp: Switches save immediately. Replies allow participation; learning saves learned information independently. Proactive messages require replies to be enabled and are available only in groups.
scSaveFailed: Could not confirm the change. The displayed switches were restored; refresh to verify server state before retrying.
scTemporaryHelp: This is a temporary runtime snapshot, not chat history. Topics and attention are not restored after restart.
scSinceReply: Time since the bot last spoke
scNoReply: No reply recorded in this runtime
scNoTopics: No active topics in this snapshot.
scProactivePaused: Unavailable while replies are off; your preference is kept.
mrUnknownHelp: The server may already have applied this change. Do not retry it blindly. Reload saved records to inspect the current state; this only reads data and keeps your draft.
mrReloadedHelp: Saved records have been reloaded, but this does not prove which request applied a change. This editor remains blocked. Close it and inspect the records before reopening an editor or adding anything again.
mmConfidenceEvidence: Stored confidence is an evidence assessment, not independently verified truth.
mmUnavailableTitle: This memory is no longer available
mmUnavailableHelp: The refreshed server records do not contain this item. Close these details to view the updated list.
stIntro: Edit one bot's identity and operating preferences. Save applies all changes on this page together.
stNameHelp: The display name used by HumanEngine.
stTimezoneHelp: An IANA timezone, such as Asia/Shanghai or UTC.
stPersonaHelp: The fixed persona for this single bot. Only manual changes here update it; learned guidance cannot rewrite it.
stWindowsHelp: These are soft preferences, not scheduled messages or permission switches. Start is inclusive and end is exclusive. Split an overnight period into two windows.
stWindowOrder: First matching window wins; otherwise balanced.
stNoWindows: No time windows. The default inclination is balanced throughout the day.
stSceneLink: Manage replies, learning and group proactivity per conversation
stWindowInvalid: Each window must end after it starts. Split overnight periods into two windows.
stDebounceHelp: Wait briefly for nearby messages before making a decision. 0–30,000 milliseconds.
stMaxWaitHelp: Upper wait for a pending message batch, not a response-time guarantee. 100–60,000 milliseconds.
stLearningDelayHelp: Collect learning work into batches. 100–300,000 milliseconds; default 30,000.
stConcurrencyHelp: Queue limit, not a spending cap. 1–32 requests; default 4. Changes apply when saved.
stCacheHelp: Temporary context is separate from durable learned memories. Up to 500 messages per conversation; it is not restored after restart. Turning this off still allows brief in-flight processing context. Recalled content remains unavailable.
stCacheHoursHelp: Default 24 hours; allowed 0.1–168 hours. The value is preserved while retention is off.
stDiagnosticsLabel: Record visible model input and output
stDiagnosticsHelp: For troubleshooting only. Server memory holds the latest 20 records for up to 15 minutes. Disabling this or restarting clears them. Hidden or encrypted reasoning is not recorded.
stDiagnosticsWarning: Visible input/output may contain private conversation content. Credential redaction does not anonymize all personal information. Keep this off when not diagnosing an issue.
stDiscardHelp: All changes on this page will be discarded. Saved settings will not change.
stDiscardLatestHelp: Your draft will be discarded and replaced with the latest saved settings. This does not undo a request that already completed.
stConflict: Saved settings changed since you opened this page. Your draft has been retained; review the latest saved version before editing again.
stReviewTitle: Check the saved settings before continuing
stUncertain: We could not confirm whether your changes were saved. Your draft is retained and Save is blocked to prevent a repeated request. Read the saved settings first.
stReconciled: The latest saved settings have been read without changing them. Your draft is still retained. You can discard it and use the saved version before making further edits; this cannot prove which request applied a change.
stUseSaved: Discard draft and use saved settings
stTimezoneInvalid: Enter a valid timezone such as Asia/Shanghai or UTC.
stDiscardUncertainHelp: Leaving or replacing this draft does not undo a change that may already have been saved. Check the saved settings before submitting the same change again.
ruIntro: One bot persona, manually authored rules, and separate low-priority learned suggestions.
ruPersonaHelp: This is the bot’s one manually configured persona. Learning cannot overwrite it. Edit it in Settings; saved changes appear in persona history. Saved persona changes apply to subsequent runtime turns.
ruPersonaUnavailable: No persona text is available in this snapshot.
ruLearnedHelp: These are low-priority suggestions learned from evidence, not manual rules. Scene conventions stay within their conversation; shared expression preferences describe the bot, not people.
ruEditorHelp: Only this rule is edited here. Save applies it; Cancel discards this editor’s changes.
ruPriorityHelp: Learned suggestions cannot override this rule. Fixed core constraints still apply.
ruDiscardHelp: Discard only the unsaved changes in this rule editor? Saved rules remain unchanged.
ruDeleteRuleHelp: Delete this saved manual rule and discard any edits to it. Other rules, the persona and learned memories are not deleted.
ruDeleteHintHelp: Delete this learned suggestion and prevent immediate relearning of the same item. This does not delete source messages or change manual rules.
ruLockHelp: Locking protects against ordinary automatic changes. Recalled evidence can still invalidate the suggestion.
ruWeightHelp: Signed weight describes direction and strength, not truth. Confidence is an evidence assessment. Manual rules and the fixed persona keep their priority.
ruHistoryHelp: Read-only history of saved changes to the same bot persona, not multiple active personas. Edit the current persona in Settings. No automatic restore is available.
ruRecoveryHelp: The change may already be saved. Reload saved records before trying anything again. Reloading only reads data and keeps your draft.
ruRecoveredHelp: Records have been reloaded. Close this window and check the current records before editing again; this window cannot repeat the uncertain change.
pgIntro: Configure built-in and trusted local plugins, manage their running state and open plugin pages.
pgStatusHelp: Enabled means the plugin is running, not that a platform connection has been verified.
pgConfigUnavailable: Configuration could not be loaded. Retry before editing.
pgNoConfig: This plugin has no configurable fields.
pgChooseHelp: Select a plugin to inspect its configuration, running state and custom pages.
pgSaveHelp: Save applies only to this plugin. If enabled, it is restarted with the new configuration, which may interrupt active work or connections. Disabled plugins stay disabled; no second reload is needed.
pgSaved: Configuration saved; an enabled plugin was restarted automatically.
pgDraftHelp: Unsaved configuration. Save or discard before changing its running state.
pgCredentialHelp: Enter the server environment variable name, such as SNOWLUMA_TOKEN, not the token itself.
pgDiscardHelp: Only the current unsaved configuration is discarded. The running plugin and saved configuration are not changed.
pgDiscardUncertain: Discarding or leaving the draft cannot undo an operation already completed by the server. Read the saved state before submitting the same operation again.
pgReloadHelp: Reload stops this plugin and starts it again. Active work and connections can be interrupted. If starting fails, it may remain disabled or in error.
pgDisableHelp: Disabling stops this plugin, removes its registered features and cancels active plugin work. Its saved configuration is retained.
pgEnableHelp: Start this trusted plugin with its saved configuration. This is not a platform-connection test.
pgConflict: Saved configuration changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained. Read and use the saved version before editing again.
pgUncertain: The operation's result could not be confirmed. Your draft is retained and further changes are blocked. Read the saved configuration and running state; no operation will be retried automatically.
pgReconciled: The saved configuration and running state have been read without making changes. Use the saved version to resume editing. Reading cannot identify which request applied a change.
pgUseSaved: Discard draft and use saved state
meIntro: Browse conversation media, review its use and sharing, and edit its tags.
meSearch: Search tags or text in images…
meDraftHelp: Changes in this window apply only when you save.
meDisableHelp: Disabling blocks use and clears availability. Re-enabling does not automatically select it for use again.
meAvailableHelp: Use still depends on analysis, valid sources and conversation scope. Disabled media cannot be used.
meSharedHelp: Existing automatic sharing remains valid. Manually enabling sharing requires a privacy review confirmation when saving.
meFavoriteHelp: A manual favorite for this asset, not evidence that users approved a bot reply.
meAnalysisHelp: Reanalysis uses the vision model and may replace tags. Manual selection and sharing choices are preserved; concurrent manual tag edits remain protected.
meSaveBeforeAnalysis: Save or discard this draft before requesting analysis.
meNoAnalysisSource: No retained source conversation is available for analysis.
meAnalyzeHelp: This sends the original media’s sampled frames and available source context to the configured vision model. Provider charges may apply. It does not send a platform message.
meShareHelp: Confirm that this material is generic and safe to share, with no private conversation details or personal information. Saving applies this media’s draft changes only; other assets are unchanged.
meDiscardHelp: Discard unsaved settings and tags for this media? Saved media and original files remain unchanged.
meRecoveryHelp: The change or model call may already have completed. Do not retry blindly. Reload saved records to inspect the result; a reload cannot prove whether a model call was charged.
meRecoveredHelp: Records were reloaded without repeating any change or model call. Close this window and review the saved item before reopening it.
ovIntro: A dated operational snapshot, not a live conversation feed.
ovStale: Refresh failed. All sections still show the previous successful snapshot; values may be outdated.
ovUnavailable: No complete snapshot is available. Refresh to try again; missing data is not a zero count.
ovConfiguredHelp: Decision and response models are assigned. Configuration is not proof of connection or capability verification.
ovNeedsSetup: Decision or response model assignment is missing. Configure it before using model-driven features.
ovUsageRange: Totals across recorded usage returned by the server, not a today-only or monthly report.
lgFetchFailed: Latest log fetch failed; displayed entries may be stale
lgNoDiagnostics: No visible model input/output is available. Capture may be off, records may have expired, or verification may have failed.
cfHelp: Test a temporary conversation, or inspect platform history without sending messages.
cfSimulationHelp: Temporary session: no real-platform sends or persistent learning. Only shared public knowledge is available. Model calls may incur charges; leaving this page ends the session.
cfUnknownSend: The request did not return a confirmed result. Your submitted text is retained below and will not be sent again automatically.
cfRecoveryHelp: Read this session to inspect received messages. Reading cannot confirm that model work has finished or whether charges occurred. End this session and create a new one before sending again.
cfCreateFailed: The session could not be created. Try starting a simulation again.
cfEndFailed: The previous session could not be confirmed as ended. No new session was started. Retry ending it before continuing.
cfEmptySimulation: Send a message to test the configured bot.
cfHistoryUnavailable: History is currently unavailable. This does not mean the conversation is empty.
cfEmptyHistory: No messages were returned within the available history range.
cfSubmittedUnknown: Submitted text · outcome unknown, not queued for retry
cfResetHelp: End this temporary session and discard its messages and unsent draft, then start a new simulation. Platform history and learned memories are not deleted. Already incurred model charges cannot be undone.
cfLeaveHelp: The unsent draft will be discarded and the temporary session will be ended. Leaving does not undo model calls already accepted.
mcEmbeddingBatchHelp: Default 4, adjustable from 1 to 64. Large input lists are sent in sequential batches; reduce this for providers with a lower limit.
mcEmbeddingBatchInvalid: Embedding batch size must be an integer from 1 to 64.
meStaticPreview: Static thumbnails; open details to play the original.
stQueueSceneHelp: Queued messages per scene. Overflow rejects newest messages and records a technical warning.
stQueueTotalHelp: Total queued messages across scenes; this cap also applies when smaller than the per-scene limit.
stRetryAttemptsHelp: Total attempts per batch, including the initial request. Retries are bounded; exhausted batches are reported.
stRetryBaseHelp: Initial retry delay; subsequent retries use bounded exponential backoff.
memoryLineageHelp: Older learned memories lack complete dependency records. Quarantined content is retained for review but excluded from recall. Verify the content, then explicitly edit it to restore it as manual knowledge; changing only the lock does not restore it.
meFeedbackHelp: Favorite is a manual flag. Feedback changes only this asset’s ranking; use count records sends, not approval. The score is not a vote count or a permanent ban.
stLearningStatusHelp: Counters cover this process only. Queued and paused source messages are held in bounded memory, never replayed after restart. Refresh to check recovery.
stLearningPartial: Partial effects may already exist; automatic or manual replay is disabled to prevent duplicate effects.
stLearningDiscardConfirm: Discard this failed batch? Its pending learning will not be retried.
groundingFallback: I cannot verify those details, so I will not assume them.
memoryRevalidateConfirm: Only confirm after independently verifying this content. It will become active manual knowledge and no longer depend on the old learned sources. This does not recover historical provenance.
eiDimensionsHelp: Blank uses the provider default. Examples: 1024 or 4096. The provider must support the requested width; returned vectors are validated, never padded or truncated. Save configuration first, then explicitly rebuild below.
eiDimensionsInvalid: Dimensions must be a whole number from 1 to 16384, or blank.
eiHelp: Configuration changes do not start a paid rebuild. Incompatible indexes use lexical retrieval until you explicitly rebuild. Staging is separate; only a fully validated generation becomes active. Refresh to reconcile an interrupted response.
eiState_needs_rebuild: Index is stale or unavailable: rebuild required
eiChargeConfirm: This explicitly starts embedding requests and may incur provider charges. A new rebuild replaces any previous paused job. Continue?
eiStopConfirm: Stop staging work? Existing active data is retained. An in-flight request may already have been billed.
eiUnknownWarning: A prior request outcome is unknown. Resuming may repeat a billed batch.
eiUnknownConfirm: I understand the unknown outcome and authorize retrying that batch.
eiResponseUnknown: The response was lost. Do not repeat the action; refresh to reconcile first.
eiActionUnavailable: The action is unavailable for the current state. Refresh before trying another action.
feedbackReceiptNegative: Recorded negative feedback for this image as a ranking reference. This operation changes neither the image’s disabled setting nor overall meme frequency.
feedbackReceiptPositive: Recorded positive feedback for this image as a ranking reference. This operation changes neither the image’s disabled setting nor overall meme frequency.
feedbackReceiptDisabled: This image was disabled when the feedback was processed.
feedbackReceiptAggregate: Recorded feedback for the relevant images as ranking references. This operation changes neither their disabled settings nor overall meme frequency.
pgEventCredential: HTTP event signature secret environment variable
pgTypingDescription: Optional delay per complete outgoing message segment, not per sentence. Disabled by default.
pgTypingSpeedHelp: 1× uses 5 graphemes/second plus 300 ms preparation. Larger factors are faster (0.1–10). Maximum 30 seconds per segment. Disabling cancels pending delays without sending.
pgEventHelp: Enter the same accessToken configured for SnowLuma HTTP event reporting. Stored encrypted in the database. The listener defaults to loopback; binding all interfaces exposes it to the network.
pgTransportHelp: WebSocket is the legacy default. HTTP uses POST actions plus a separately configured authenticated event listener. Saving disabled settings does not connect.
pgSnowDescription: Built-in SnowLuma adapter: WebSocket or HTTP actions and signed HTTP events. Existing account, scene IDs and enable state are preserved.

pluginStartupErrors.plugin_setup_failed: Plugin startup failed. Review the sanitized plugin diagnostics.
pluginStartupErrors.plugin_disabled: Startup was cancelled. Refresh the plugin state before retrying.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_plugin_configuration: Save a valid plugin configuration before enabling it.
pluginStartupErrors.credential_not_configured: No database credential is saved. Enter a value before enabling; a legacy environment reference may also be used.
pluginStartupErrors.event_credential_not_configured: Enter the same accessToken configured for SnowLuma HTTP event reporting. Stored encrypted in the database. The listener defaults to loopback; binding all interfaces exposes it to the network.
pluginStartupErrors.account_mismatch: SnowLuma reported a different bot account. Check the configured account ID and the connected instance.
pluginStartupErrors.connection_failed: WebSocket connection failed. Check the Universal forward WebSocket endpoint, token and reachability from the HumanEngine container. Container localhost is not the host or another container.
pluginStartupErrors.request_timeout: The account handshake timed out. Check the SnowLuma service and network; startup was stopped safely.
pluginStartupErrors.http_event_listen_failed: Cannot bind the HTTP event listener. Check whether its port is occupied or its bind address is available inside the container.
pluginStartupErrors.http_action_failed: The HTTP action endpoint returned an unsuccessful HTTP response. Check its base URL, token and service.
pluginStartupErrors.http_request_failed: HTTP connection failed. Check reachability from the HumanEngine container and the SnowLuma HTTP action endpoint.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_http_response: The endpoint did not return a valid OneBot HTTP response. Check the action base URL and protocol.
pluginStartupErrors.platform_action_failed: SnowLuma rejected the account handshake action. Inspect SnowLuma service diagnostics; no connection was enabled.
pluginStartupErrors.connection_closed: WebSocket connection failed. Check the Universal forward WebSocket endpoint, token and reachability from the HumanEngine container. Container localhost is not the host or another container.
pluginStartupErrors.request_cancelled: Startup was cancelled. Refresh the plugin state before retrying.
pluginStartupErrors.adapter_disposed: Startup was cancelled. Refresh the plugin state before retrying.
pluginStartupErrors.adapter_not_connected: WebSocket connection failed. Check the Universal forward WebSocket endpoint, token and reachability from the HumanEngine container. Container localhost is not the host or another container.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_websocket_url: Save a valid plugin configuration before enabling it.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_http_url: Save a valid plugin configuration before enabling it.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_http_event_configuration: Save a valid plugin configuration before enabling it.
pluginStartupErrors.http_response_too_large: The endpoint did not return a valid OneBot HTTP response. Check the action base URL and protocol.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_payload: The endpoint did not return a valid OneBot HTTP response. Check the action base URL and protocol.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_identifier: The endpoint did not return a valid OneBot HTTP response. Check the action base URL and protocol.
pluginStartupErrors.unsupported: SnowLuma rejected the account handshake action. Inspect SnowLuma service diagnostics; no connection was enabled.
pluginStartupErrors.invalid_action_parameters: SnowLuma rejected the account handshake action. Inspect SnowLuma service diagnostics; no connection was enabled.
pluginStartupErrors.secret_key_unavailable: The credential database cannot be decrypted. Restore the matching installation key and check its permissions; do not delete or regenerate the key.
pluginStartupErrors.secret_key_missing: The credential database cannot be decrypted. Restore the matching installation key and check its permissions; do not delete or regenerate the key.
pluginStartupErrors.secret_key_permissions: The credential database cannot be decrypted. Restore the matching installation key and check its permissions; do not delete or regenerate the key.
pluginStartupErrors.secret_key_invalid: The credential database cannot be decrypted. Restore the matching installation key and check its permissions; do not delete or regenerate the key.
pluginStartupErrors.secret_decryption_failed: The credential database cannot be decrypted. Restore the matching installation key and check its permissions; do not delete or regenerate the key.

mcCredentialPreserve: Leave blank to keep saved key
mcCredentialEnvHelp: Not required. Used only when no database key exists. Clear this too to disable a legacy credential.
pgSnowTokenHelp: Enter the token configured in SnowLuma. It is encrypted in the database; no environment variable is required. Leave blank to keep the existing value.
pgSnowAccountHelp: The QQ number logged into this SnowLuma instance (get_login_info.user_id), not a group number or plugin ID.
pgCredentialStored: A credential is saved. Its value is never returned; leave blank to preserve it.
pgCredentialMissing: No database credential is saved. Enter a value before enabling; a legacy environment reference may also be used.
pgLegacyCredentialHelp: Compatibility only. Leave blank when using a database-backed credential; a saved database value takes precedence.

pgValidation.invalid_type: Use the expected value type for this field.
pgValidation.invalid_value: Check this field’s permitted format or values.
pgValidation.invalid_url: Enter a complete valid endpoint URL.
pgValidation.websocket_scheme_required: WebSocket requires ws:// or wss://, for example ws://127.0.0.1:3001. An IP:port alone is not a URL.
pgValidation.http_scheme_required: HTTP requires http:// or https://, for example http://127.0.0.1:3001.
pgValidation.url_credentials_forbidden: Do not put a username or password in the URL. Use the token field.
pgValidation.url_query_forbidden: Remove URL query parameters; enter the token in its separate field.
pgValidation.invalid_event_path: Use a path beginning with / and only letters, numbers, /, _ or -; do not use //.
pgValidation.invalid_port: Use a whole-number port from 1 to 65535.
pgValidation.conflicting_credential_change: Choose either a new secret or clear the saved secret, not both.

pgValidationSummary: Correct the highlighted fields before saving.
pgSnowWsUrlHelp: Enter the complete Universal forward WebSocket URL, including ws:// or wss://. Do not enter only IP:port.
pgSnowHttpUrlHelp: Enter the complete HTTP API URL, including http:// or https://.
authExpired: Your session has expired or ended. Please sign in again.
authLogoutFailed: Could not end the server session. Retry disconnecting before leaving this browser.
entityEditorUnavailable: Cannot open the editor because this browser cannot generate an ID. Update the browser or use HTTPS, then retry.
modelConfigNotReady: Model configuration has not loaded yet. Reload the configuration and try again.
pgWebDescription: Search public web sources with structured, untrusted results. Disabled by default; queries are shared with the selected external provider.
pgWebProviderHelp: Bing, Google, Sogou and DuckDuckGo use experimental public HTML. Tavily, You and DeepSeek use official APIs. you_news reads the news section of You unified search.
pgWebFallbackHelp: Default: none. An explicitly selected fallback is attempted once after provider failure, may incur charges, and shares the total timeout. Empty results do not trigger fallback.
pgWebHtmlHelp: Required for HTML providers. Markup, CAPTCHA or redirects may make search unavailable. DuckDuckGo HTML is not DDGS multi-engine search. No challenge bypass or result-page fetching.
pgWebKeyHelp: Stored encrypted in the database. Leave blank to preserve; select Clear to delete. Never include credentials or private conversation in search queries.
pgWebKeyMissing: No saved key. Required only if this API provider is selected as primary or fallback.
pgWebRequiredKeyMissing: The selected API provider has no saved key. Enter and save it on this page.

mcProviderRetriesHelp: Default: 2 extra retries (up to 3 attempts). Set 0 to disable retries. All models and operations of this provider inherit this setting.
mcProviderTimeoutHelp: Default: 30000 ms (30 seconds) per attempt. Retries and backoff share the remaining stage budget, so the stage may stop earlier.
mcRouteBudgetHelp: Total budget across model calls, retries, fallback candidates and tool rounds. Existing values are preserved; new routes default to 180000 ms.
mcProviderRequestInvalid: Enter an integer retry count from 0 to 5 and a per-attempt timeout from 100 to 300000 milliseconds.
